tagline.zh: 数值从 0 滚到终点的计数动画:@property --num 注册变量做 CSS 插值,或 rAF 逐帧递增;仪表盘指标的标配。
tagline.en: A counter that rolls from 0 to its target: CSS interpolation on a registered @property --num variable, or per-frame rAF increments — the dashboard-stat staple.

origin.zh: CSS-Tricks《Animating Number Counters》(含评论区可访问性讨论):@property --num 注册 <integer> 变量 → transition/keyframes 插值 → counter-reset + counter() 显示;JS 侧等价做法是 rAF 逐帧递增(调研 04§2.5)。
origin.en: CSS-Tricks' "Animating Number Counters" (incl. the comment-thread accessibility discussion): register an <integer> variable via @property --num, interpolate it with transition/keyframes, display via counter-reset + counter(); the JS-side equivalent is per-frame rAF increments (research 04 §2.5).

effect.zh: 计数总时长。css-tricks 给出的可调维度是「时长与缓动可调、animation-fill-mode: forwards 停在终值」,未记载默认数值——本条目的 1200ms 为社区常见值,未证实。
effect.en: Total count duration. css-tricks documents the adjustable dimensions (duration and easing, animation-fill-mode: forwards to hold the final value) but no default number — this entry's 1200ms is a common community value, unverified.

effect.zh: 计数终值(起点恒为 0;起始/终值在 css-tricks 的可调维度之列)。默认 2026 是本站演示用值,非官方数值。
effect.en: Target value of the count (start is always 0; start/target are among css-tricks' adjustable dimensions). The default 2026 is this site's demo value, not an official number.

effect.zh: 小数位。纯 CSS 方案用 calc() 拆整数/小数位分别渲染(css-tricks);demo 的 rAF 方案对连续值直接 toFixed。默认 0 为演示用值。
effect.en: Fractional digits. The pure-CSS approach splits integer/decimal parts via calc() (css-tricks); the demo's rAF path applies toFixed to the continuous value. Default 0 is a demo value.

note.zh: rAF 与 CSS counter 全浏览器可用;@property 属 CSS Houdini Properties and Values API,已 Baseline widely available(调研 09§1.2/§1.6)。demo 采用 rAF 计数,不依赖 @property。
note.en: rAF and CSS counters work everywhere; @property belongs to the CSS Houdini Properties and Values API and is Baseline widely available (research 09 §1.2/§1.6). The demo counts via rAF and does not rely on @property.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 时直出终值(css-tricks 评论区实测建议:屏读读到的是中间值,故 reduce 应跳过滚动);同时给读屏一条只含终值的 sr-only 文本,动画节点 aria-hidden。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion, output the final value directly (css-tricks' comment-thread recommendation: screen readers hear intermediate values, so reduce should skip the roll); additionally provide an sr-only text with the final value and keep the animated node aria-hidden.

use.zh: 仪表盘指标首次载入后的数值揭晓
use.en: Revealing a dashboard metric right after its data arrives

use.zh: 年度报告/战绩页的总量与涨幅数字
use.en: Totals and deltas on annual reports or stats pages

use.zh: 计数器类落地页的「里程碑」展示(播放一次)
use.en: One-shot milestone counters on marketing pages

avoid.zh: 高频刷新的实时数据——持续滚动让读数永远对不上真实值
avoid.en: Frequently refreshed live data — a perpetually rolling number never matches reality

avoid.zh: 表格/密集数据列——逐格滚动制造持续视觉噪声
avoid.en: Tables and dense data columns — cell-by-cell rolls create constant visual noise

avoid.zh: 把滚动作为数值的唯一信息载体——读屏听到的是初值或中间值
avoid.en: Letting the roll be the sole carrier of the value — screen readers hear the start or a mid value

a11y.zh: 屏幕阅读器读到的是初值或中间值(css-tricks 评论区实测:VoiceOver 读出 8/61 而视觉停在 100)→ 动画节点 aria-hidden,另给 sr-only 终值;prefers-reduced-motion 直出终值;hover 触发需补 :focus 与 tabindex(css-tricks 建议)。
a11y.en: Screen readers read the start or an intermediate value (css-tricks comment thread, measured: VoiceOver read 8/61 while the visual settled at 100) → keep the animated node aria-hidden and add an sr-only final value; under prefers-reduced-motion output the final value directly; if hover-triggered, add :focus and tabindex (css-tricks' advice).

goal.zh: 复刻一块仪表盘指标卡:数值从 0 滚到参数快照的终值,时长与小数位按快照,千位分隔、等宽数字,动画节点对读屏隐藏并另给静态终值。
goal.en: Replicate a dashboard stat card: the value rolls from 0 to the snapshot target over the snapshot duration and digits, with thousands separators and tabular numerals; hide the animated node from screen readers and provide a static final value.

acceptance.zh: 用 @property --num(<integer>) 或 rAF 实现计数,起点 0、终点为快照终值
acceptance.en: Count via @property --num (<integer>) or rAF, from 0 to the snapshot target

acceptance.zh: 时长与缓动按参数快照,结束后精确停在终值(fill forwards / 终帧强制)
acceptance.en: Duration and easing follow the snapshot and land exactly on the target (fill forwards / forced final frame)

acceptance.zh: 数字用 tabular-nums + 千位分隔,小数位按快照
acceptance.en: Numerals are tabular with thousands separators; fractional digits follow the snapshot

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时跳过滚动直出终值
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, skip the roll and show the final value

acceptance.zh: 动画节点 aria-hidden,sr-only 文本携带终值供读屏
acceptance.en: Animated node is aria-hidden; an sr-only text carries the final value for screen readers
